details:
Ive seen some avatars having a generic synced parameter.  And using this parameter to sync local parameters one by one depending on which is changed to save parameter memory. I think this really needs to be a built in feature, especially for bigger more complex avatars with things like face tracking. The main purpose would be to not increase the avatars total memory (Except for each shared synced type).

This could be implemented as a setting like "Limit Update", adding some tool tip like "Only send one of these updated parameters per network update".

Maybe even having the "Limited Updates" option being something else like an integer, representing groups of these shared synced parameters (Use case example could be having multiple simultaneous groups/shared parameters for duel axis puppets).

Another idea could also be having another integer for the whole avatar parameter object that the user can set how many bits/parameters they want to send per network packet for the selected parameters.  This might be better than the grouping idea, or even work with it somehow.

I dont know if VRC only sends changed parameters over the network already, but if they are, I could see this being a simple addition where some variables are simply skipped depending on what has been serialized already.
title: Avatar parameter space saving by limiting network updates
